$comment: Advisory warning thresholds measured by tools/vitest/budgetReporter.mjs on every run. Per-file imports, individual tests and whole-suite totals retain measurements and exceedance details without failing the run. Totals are per-file sums, not wall clock, and vary with machine load.
$comment_maxTestMs: Advisory test-duration threshold only; DOM wait failures remain functional test failures independent of this warning.
$comment_baseline: Page tests that render conversation markdown load streamdown. testMs is a per-file sum, so it grows when workers contend. Mermaid, LaTeX, and streamdown's code plugin are not part of this suite.
